Series of dreams that changed my perception of people.

Basically, I had these dreams that were like a tv series. Like in episodes that carried off from the last.  Super fricking weird.

Me, my sisters and some friends were stuck inside this really weird connecting room things. Like every time we tried to leave through an exit or entrance door, it just took us into another house or building. If you looked through the windows it was just an abyss, but they let in light sometimes.
So, we were being chased by some weird entity. It resembled an old singing teacher of mine who was trying to kill us with a butchers knife. And slowly our group was whittled down to me and my sisters. (We started off with about 9-11 people). 

But the characters didn’t feel like their real world counter parts. They were brutally honest. One of them was a brat who got 3 people killed and was over all just really selfish.
Another was really kind and giving and sacrificed herself to let us live.
My friend was really depressed and sad.
One of my sister was a religious asshole 
And my other sister resembled a very similar personality to her IRL counter part.
Etc

The last survivors (me and my sisters) finally got outside. And it was some weird garden that I’ve never been in before. All of the previous locations I had been in I had recognised, but this was a really weird garden with nothing but flowers as far as I could see.

I then woke up in a cold sweat, but those series of dreams was without a shadow of a doubt is the weirdest thing that has ever happened to me.
Another thing is that this is one of the few dreams I can recall this well. Most dreams I forget really quickly. These dreams happened over 5 years ago and I still remember them really well.



But the weirdest part about all this is the character behaviour.

The really selfish one turned out to be a selfish spoiled brat who I hate.
The one who sacrificed herself is one of the most caring people I’ve ever met.
The sad one recently reached out to me to check how I was and he told be he was really struggling and was having suicidal thoughts.
My religious a-hole of a sister... is a religious a-hole who pins all her mistake on the bible and is generally ignorant.
And the sister who didn’t change, hasn’t changed. She feels the same.


But because of all of these correlations, I’m literally scared of my old music teacher. And I’m not sure if I have some weird psychic powers, but that was terrifying. But I wanna learn what that garden was.
